sentences.text:
Judgement and order dated 23.07.2004 rendered by the learned Additional Sessions  J u d g e , J u n a g a d h a t V e r a v a l r e c o r d i n g a c q u i t t a l f o r  respondent in Criminal Appeal No. 33 of 2001 while reversing judgement and  order of conviction rendered by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, 
Veraval in Criminal Case No. 2638 of 1992 for the offence punishable under  Section 7(1) read with section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act R/CR.A/120/2005 JUDGMENT ( For short ' P.F.A. Act'), has been assailed in this appeal under section 378 of  the Code of Criminal Procedure ( for short 'Cr.P.C').
2. Having considered the rival contentions, it transpires that the  F o o d I n s p e c t o r h a d c o l l e c t e d t h e s a m p l e o f g r o u n d n u t o i l w e i g h i n g 4 0 0  gms out of the container weighing 6 or 7 kg.

on 04.08.1992 at 14.00 hours, from the shop of  t h e r e s p o n d e n t a n d t h e s a m e h a v i n g b e e n  found containing castor oil and thus adulterated, complaint came to be lodged against the  respondent under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
3 . O n p e r u s a l o f t h e t e s t i m o n y o f t h e F o o d I n s p e c t o r a t E x h .
1 9 , i t i s  n o t i c e d t h a t t h e c o n t a i n e r o f t h e f o o d a r t i c l e w a s 7 k g .
w h e r e f r o m t h e  sample was drawn.
He has stated that before drawing the sample, the container was stirred to  make it homogeneous but has not named homogenizer or apparatus used for the  purpose of stirring.
It was obligatory on his part to prove the said fact so as to  show that the homogenizer or apparatus used was good and capable of stirring whole  quantity of 7 kg.

That apart, he did not come out with clear case that the vessel in which the  s a m p l e w a s d r a w n a n d t h e v e s s e l i n w h i c h t h e  sample was divided into three parts, were cleaned on the spot.
He also did not come out with  t h e c a s e t h a t a f t e r c o l l e c t i o n o f t h e s a m p l e  weighing 400 gms., it was homogenized by stirring before dividing it into three parts.
Thus, it is  apparent from his testimony that neither the vessels were cleaned nor the samples of  groundnut oil were convincingly homogenized.

In the opinion of this court, the  appellate court was therefore, justified in reversing the judgement and order of  conviction in view of the settled legal position that the vessel in which the sample is collected is  required to be cleaned and the sample is R/CR.A/120/2005 JUDGMENT required to be homogenized.
In absence of adhering to such procedure, Rule 14 of the  P r e v e n t i o n F o o d A d u l t e r a t i o n R u l e s w o u l d s t a n d  breached, entitling the accused to the benefit of doubt.
4. For the foregoing reasons, no substance is found in this appeal.
Appeal fails and is dismissed.

(G.R.UDHWANI, J) niru*
